# AIRAD LABS

> AIRAD LABS creates and stewards ATEP, the open Autonomy Trust Envelope Protocol, a quantum-safe way, working even offline, for robots and AI agents from different vendors to verify who sent a message, that it was not altered, and what certifications the sender holds. Early stage: the protocol, reference implementations in Rust, JavaScript and Python, and a demo exist. Planned and not yet available: certification, a hosted registry and transparency log, and the ATEP Fleet Console. No customers or issued certificates are claimed.

- [Home](https://airadlabs.com/index.html): plain answers on multi-vendor robot fleet trust and quantum-safe command authentication
- [Why ATEP](https://airadlabs.com/why-atep.html): why TLS is not enough, why open, why quantum-safe
- [Products](https://airadlabs.com/products.html): planned offerings and what exists today
- [About](https://airadlabs.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://airadlabs.com/contact.html): security reports to nathan@airadlabs.com; general contact is being set up
- [ATEP protocol site](https://atep.dev/): specification, quick start, test vectors, governance
- [ATEP llms.txt](https://atep.dev/llms.txt)
